name: whatsapp-agent
description: Posts the daily ledger-change feed to a private family WhatsApp group, from Dad's phone. See docs/PLAN_WHATSAPP_AGENT_TERMUX.md.

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (+process.versions.node.split('.')[0] < 20) { console.error('Node 20 or newer is required — found ' + process.versions.node + '. In Termux: pkg install nodejs-lts'); process.exit(1); }"
